title: Restore Hero-system richness with the native YEIS system generator

scope.subject: AURORA ExtraSystem companion-world composition under the YEIS mother model

research_summary: Runtime regression testing of the YEIS model bridge showed AURORA SYSTEM collapsed from a populated flagship system to a single Hero planet because the current ExtraSystem body factory contains only HELION and AURORA-01. Reintroducing V2 companions would preserve two competing model authorities. The selected YEIS MIT snapshot already has a deterministic SystemGenerator that builds complete systems from StarInfo. Reuse it for HELION, replace the generated planet nearest AURORA's authored 1.08 AU orbit with AURORA-01, remove only moons belonging to that replaced planet, and retain all other native YEIS-generated companions. This exact composition was already runtime-smoked locally and produced six worlds while preserving the Hero surface path.

sources.finding: The pinned MIT generator deterministically creates a complete multi-planet system and moons from StarInfo, so it can supply HELION's ordinary companion worlds without V2.
ExtraSystem accepts a BodyData factory, allowing native generated bodies to be composed with one authored Hero replacement without modifying normal YEIS generation.

search_ladder.conclusion: The selected YEIS mother already contains the required full system-generation capability; no second product or engine is needed.
Reuse generateSystem(StarInfo) directly and compose the Hero override at the BodyData boundary.
Both YEIS and the old V2/Helios-derived generator can populate companions, but only YEIS preserves one model authority.
No new renderer or asset is needed; the regression is purely system-data composition.

coverage_matrix.decision: Do not revive V2 in the Hero path.

coverage_matrix.capability: preserve authored AURORA identity and surface
coverage_matrix.decision: Replace one native generated orbital slot with the existing AURORA BodyData.
Keep the adapter narrow and leave generation to upstream YEIS.

candidates.name: YEIS SystemGenerator companions + one AURORA replacement
candidates.reason: Restores flagship-system richness without reviving V2 or hand-authoring filler worlds.

candidates.name: Keep old V2 companions around AURORA
candidates.reason: Would leave two competing procedural system models alive in the same flagship system.

candidates.name: Author fixed filler planets beside AURORA
candidates.reason: Creates bespoke filler data the selected mother already generates more consistently.

candidates.name: Keep AURORA SYSTEM as a one-planet exception
candidates.reason: Runtime regression showed an unnecessarily sparse flagship system.

decision.rationale: Generate a normal deterministic HELION system with the selected YEIS mother, then substitute AURORA at one orbital slot. This preserves the authored Hero while restoring native system richness and continuing the removal of V2 model authority.

higher_level_tradeoffs.reason: It restores count immediately but keeps duplicate model authority, which is worse globally than native YEIS composition.

decision.fallback: If HELION generation ever yields no replaceable planet, retain the generated star/system and append AURORA; never fall back to V2 generation.
